💬 Mock interviews are super important when you're preparing for investment banking interviews. 

They give you a chance to practice and get comfortable with the whole process. 🤔 Remember that knowing the answer is one thing, but being able to explain it out loud is a whole different ballgame!

Another huge advantage of mock interviews is the feedback you get. 💡 Whether it’s from friends or mentors, they can offer valuable insights into what you did well and what you might need to improve. 

This feedback is pure gold! 💪 It helps you fine-tune your answers and sharpen your skills, making you a stronger candidate when it’s time to meet with actual employers.

Interested in doing mock interviews with our mentors? 📥 DM us your email or click the link in our bio to join the WSO Academy waitlist. 

🚨 Don’t wait too long—we only accept a limited number of students!

description:
Seorang pria di Bandung menjadi korban kekerasan dan pengerusakan. Kejadian itu terjadi di kawasan SPBU Jl. Soekarno Hatta, Kelurahan Sekejati, Kecamatan Buah Batu, Kota Bandung pada hari Sabtu, 28 Desember 2024 sekitar pukul 19.17 WIB.

Dari keterangan korban, saat itu pelaku meminta uang dengan cara mengetuk kaca mobil menggunakan batu ali yang dipakainya sehingga menimbulkan suara yang keras ke dalam mobil dan berperilaku tidak sopan kepada korban.

Lalu terjadi pertikaian antara korban dan pelaku, kemudian korban kembali ke dalam mobilnya dan pelaku memukul bagian kaca mobilnya hingga pecah.

Saat ini pelaku sudah membuat laporan ke Polsek Buah Batu.

description:
Alô @andrelopesfilmagens 

Uma van modelo Renault Master foi completamente destruída por um incêndio na noite desta sexta-feira (7), em um trecho da BA-120, nas proximidades da localidade de Braúna, no município de Santaluz, região sisaleira da Bahia.

O veículo era conduzido pelo ex-vereador Rizonaldo Moura do Carmo, de 61 anos, conhecido como **Riva da Volta da Serra. Ele conseguiu sair do automóvel a tempo e não sofreu ferimentos.
Segundo Riva, a van havia sido comprada na quinta-feira (6), e ele viajou até Serrinha, na mesma região, para buscá-la. No retorno para Santaluz, ao se aproximar da sede do município, percebeu fumaça saindo do motor.

Rapidamente, ele estacionou o veículo e saiu antes que as chamas se alastrassem e destruíssem toda a estrutura da van.

Ainda não há informações sobre o que pode ter causado o incêndio. Equipes da Guarda Civil Municipal e da Polícia Militar estiveram no local para registrar a ocorrência e auxiliar na organização do trânsito na rodovia.

As autoridades devem investigar o caso para determinar se o fogo teve origem em uma falha mecânica, elétrica ou outro fator.

Decided to make a fun video of Linda’s big transformation! 

Linda came to me wanting to be able to let her natural grey grow in so she can eventually stop coloring her hair.

•to start off this process I went in and did a full application of a mixture of highlights and low lights using @redken  #upto7 and #colorfusion 
•while the highlights and lowlights were processing I took the hair that was left out and glossed that separately with #shadeseq gloss 
•when the highlights were done processing I rinsed it out and tone them using a different gloss formula. 
•leaving her with the natural salt and pepper look she wanted 😍
•total time in salons was approximately 5 hours!

MAQUIA E FALA - O dia que levei um golpe em uma empresa que trabalhei.

É realezas, nada é fácil nessa vida, no final do ano passado passei por essa experiência inusitada, e a vida sempre tem dessas rasteiras quando se menos espera! O importante é confiar em Deus, e fazer o seu melhor. O que passou, ficou pra trás, seja livramento ou proteção divina.
A vida continua, e Deus abre portas novas, caminhos novos e oportunidades! Que saibamos  aproveitar o agora! E ser grato pelas coisas boas que acontecem, e as coisas boas que vão acontecer! Coisas boas estão por vir. Você tá pronto?

Tersangka yang merupakan tetangga korban masih buron dan belum dimasukkan dalam Daftar Pencarian Orang (DPO). "Kita ingin dihargai, tapi sudahkah kita menghargai diri sendiri? 🤔"

Orang lain akan menilai kita sebagaimana kita membawa diri. Kalau kita sendiri gak percaya diri dan ragu-ragu, orang lain juga akan melihat kita seperti itu.

Jadi, sebelum berharap dihargai orang lain, mulailah dengan menghargai diri sendiri. Berjalan dengan kepala tegak, percaya pada kemampuanmu, dan tunjukkan siapa dirimu yang sebenarnya! ✨

Setuju? Drop komentar "Aku menghargai diri sendiri!" 💪🔥

#SelfWorth #PercayaDiri #HargaiDiriSendiri #MindsetPositif #PersonalGrowth #MotivasiHidup #MentalHealthAwareness #SelfLoveJourney #InspirationDaily #KontenMotivasi

Sebagai seorang siswa di Papua, saya ingin menyampaikan rasa terima kasih yang mendalam kepada Pak Jokowi. Selama 10 tahun terakhir, saya melihat banyak perubahan positif yang membawa harapan baru bagi daerah kami. Proyek-proyek infrastruktur, seperti pembangunan jalan tol, telah membuka akses dan memberi kesempatan lebih bagi siswa dan mahasiswa untuk belajar dan berkembang.

Saya sangat berharap agar daerah kami terus dikembangkan, sehingga kami bisa meraih cita-cita dengan lebih mudah. Dengan kepemimpinan yang baik, saya yakin masa depan kami akan lebih cerah. Saya ingin mengucapkan terima kasih kepada Yayasan Puteri Indonesia yang telah memberi saya kesempatan untuk berbincang langsung dengan Pak Jokowi. Momen itu sangat berarti bagi saya dan memberikan harapan yang baik untuk masa depan. 

Saya berharap dimasa kepemimpinan yang telah ditabiskan ini , Pak Prabowo dapat melanjutkan pembangunan yang telah dilakukan, khususnya untuk meningkatkan pendidikan dan infrastruktur di seluruh Indonesia. Semoga visi dan misi beliau dapat membawa perubahan yang positif, memberikan lebih banyak peluang bagi siswa dan mahasiswa di seluruh Indonesia untuk meraih cita-cita.

Mari kita terus berdoa dan bekerja sama untuk memajukan Indonesia. JAYALAH, INDONESIAKU!

Get ready for an unforgettable evening filled with elegance, purpose, and powerful voices—led by the incredible Pretty Yanny!

Let’s celebrate community, self-expression, and the brilliance of women who light up every room they walk into.

description:
Sejak SD, Tiko hanya tinggal berdua dengan ibunya yang memiliki gangguan kejiwaan dan harus bekerja untuk mencukupi kebutuhan. 

Hal ini membuat Tiko tak dapat bersekolah dan rumahnya juga mulai tak terurus. Mulai dari menjual makanan, hingga menjadi petugas keamanan dijalaninya. 

Karna keterbatasan biaya, Tiko dan ibunya terpaksa harus hidup tanpa listrik dan air. Kini Tiko dapat bernapas lega dengan kesembuhan sang ibu. 

Tak hanya itu, Tiko juga telah memiliki istri dan seorang anak. Bagi Nadiyah istrinya, Tiko adalah sosok teladan untuk tetap kuat dalam menjalani kehidupan. 

Saksikan kisah selengkapnya hari ini, 15 Desember pukul 10.30 WIB di DAAI TV dan YouTube: Hati ke Hati

Jadi weekend kali ini mau ke mana, Sobat? Yuk ke Sarinah aja, dapatkan produk-produk terbaik UMKM minta binaan Pertamina di PaDi UMKM EXPO selama 11-14 Juli 2024. Banyak doorprize dan hiburannya lho!

description:
Super receta para que tus huevos de pascua sean un éxito 🐰✨⁣
ATENCIÓN,  MIRÁ HASTA EL FINAL QUE TE DEJAMOS UN SUPER TIP 😎⁣
⁣
1. Vamos a usar baño de repostería para moldeo⁣
2. Para derretirlo tenemos dos opciones: ⁣
𝗠𝗶𝗰𝗿𝗼𝗼𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘀 (intervalos de 30’’ y cada vez que lo saques revolver) ⁣
𝗕𝗮ñ𝗼 𝗠𝗮𝗿í𝗮: Si es tu primera vez te aconsejamos que utilices bowls de plástico (apto para calor). Colocamos agua caliente en un recipiente y arriba de este el bowl con el chocolate, y revolvemos.  𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗿𝗱𝗮́: “𝗘𝗹 𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗰𝗼𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝘀𝗲 𝗱𝗲𝗿𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗽𝗼𝗿 𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗼𝗿 𝘆 𝗳𝗿𝗶𝗰𝗰𝗶𝗼́𝗻” ⁣
3. Cuando logres fluidez y temperatura para trabajar (la mayoría de los baños rondan los 38° 40°) estamos listos 💪⁣
4. Limpiamos bien los moldes y colocamos el chocolate.⁣
5. Damos vuelta sobre una placa o superficie plana, y llevamos a 𝗳𝗿í𝗼 para acelerar su secado 𝗢𝗝𝗢, 𝗻𝗼 𝘁𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝘀𝗲𝘀 𝗱𝗲 𝗳𝗿í𝗼 !! luego desmoldamos.⁣
6. Para pegar las cáscaras coloca una placa lisa que puedas darle calor.⁣
7. Las capas de choco dependen del tamaño del huevo. 𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗰𝗶𝗼́𝗻: 2 capas huevos chicos (hasta el número 8) a partir de ahí 3 capas, hasta el n°12 y los más grandes más capas 😉.⁣
⁣
𝗧𝗜𝗣: Para cerrarlos con el mismo chocolate utilizá alcohol alimenticio, licor a base de leche o agua fría. Agregá unas gotitas hasta lograr la consistencia deseada, debe ser “como una crema” o punto Chantilly.⁣
Los detalle dorados los realizamos con polvos matizadores que mezclamos con alcohol alimenticio.⁣
⁣

description:
What a surreal week it’s been so far. Leaving the fresh spring air in England & arriving in a hot humid climate in the Philippines. 

One minute I’m planting in my very English garden in the UK and the next I’m here with my mum and dad on an island called Palawan, with the most beautiful tropical gardens and sea view. Yes I’m missing @shopper_dave terribly and also my youngest cheeky Charlie and I can’t wait to see them next weekend! The FaceTime’s just aren’t the same as the real hugs and kisses 😞 

For now, I’m really enjoying spending time with my parents. I take them for granted so much when I’m back in England and then I come here & realise just how amazing they are (Wish we lived closer). If you’ve seen my stories youll know what I mean. It’s truly stunning out here, a totally different way of life. (All in highlights if you’ve missed them). 

My love for gardening definitely emulates from my mum, her garden is absolutely stunning and she’s  created a flowerful wonderland by the sea. The dedication to rebuilding this amazing space after the typhoon destroyed it all is beyond admirable. I’ll share more of the garden on my stories 😊

For those of you who are all about gardening, where did your passion come from?

POV: you will get the best shoulder PUMP after doing this exercise ‼️

I - Y - T Shoulder Triple Set 🔥

The only thing better than a superset for a shoulder pump is a TRIPLE SET!!
This exercise targets the upper, middle AND lower traps in one exercise🤩

SAVE this to try on your next upper body day‼️

👇How to perform the exercise correctly:
1- Keep your arms straight and (I) lift your arms straight ahead 
2- Then (Y) lift your arms at a Y shape
3- Lastly (T) lift your arms straight outward

👇Tips on completing the exercise:
1. Use lighter weight 
2. Perform as one of your first shoulder exercises before compound lifts
3. Keep your shoulders down
4. Keep your breathing steady 
5. Best practices is 3 sets of 10-12

🟠La abogada Sonia Weisheim encabeza la lista de candidatos del sublema Ciudad Sustentable para el Concejo Deliberante de Posadas. En el programa Cadena de Noticias, que se emite por la señal C6Digital, comentó acerca de las propuestas del equipo para los vecinos de la ciudad. «Tenemos muchos tópicos que surgen de la necesidad de la gente», expresó.

Entre otras cuestiones hizo referencia a la problemática de la tenencia responsable de mascotas como también en la temática vinculada al ambiente.

«Vengo de la actividad privada y creo que nosotros tenemos que apostar al desarrollo de las industrias. Otras de las cuestiones que mueve muchísimo la economía es la producción. Entonces, a través de lo que se conoce como Certificaciones Verdes se puede llegar al sector privado, acompañarlos en políticas sostenibles, sustentables para evitar así multas, clausuras, capacitar y para que la inversión que realiza sea acompañada por el Estado», puntualizó.

💰💰 DOLPHIN CATAMARAN CRUISE!🐬 @sailcocoabeach is the perfect relaxing way to enjoy what Florida has to offer and see dolphins, manatees, and plenty of avian species in the wild. I’ve done both this cruise and their Sunset Catamaran cruise and both are the best time. Dolphins are typically more active in the morning/afternoon so your chances of seeing them during the dolphin cruise are greater.  This experience is very family-friendly and comes with complimentary water, sodas, and pictures. Each catamaran hosts up to 32 sailors, so this is the perfect experience for large groups. Book your experience at cocoabeachcatamaran.com today. Follow @sunshineandkeylimeblog for more Florida spots!

What it costs:
🐬 Adults/Seniors: $40-$45 ($45-$49 for sunset sail)
🐬 Kids 13 & younger: $29.50
🐬 Kids 2 & younger: FREE

Private charters and sails are available as well!

📍290 Marine Harbor Drive, Merritt Island, FL, 32953

description:
Tout le monde parle d’avoir un métabolisme lent, rapide ou bloqué 

Et bah spoiler alert, tous ces termes, n’existent pas 🤷‍♂️ 

Par contre un métabolisme s’adapte à ce que tu lui fournis ! Et en s’adaptant, il va induire des réponses adéquates à notre environnement. 

Une personne qui ne perd plus du poids va dire que son métabolisme est bloqué ou qu’il ralentit alors qu’en réalité. Son métabolisme va lui fournir simplement moins d’énergie donc inconsciemment cette personne va moins bouger, s’entraîner moins lourd, moins bien dormir, et possiblement perturber son système hormonale. 

Donc je le répète, NON, un métabolisme ne ralentit pas, il ne se bloque pas, et il n’accélère pas non plus. Il s’ADAPTE et propose des réponses en fonction de ces adaptations 😉

If you’re looking for easy-peasy travel plans in 2025… start with these countries where Indians get visa-free or e-visa entry! 🇮🇳✈️

🇧🇹 Bhutan – No visa needed! Just an entry permit on arrival. Cheap, quick, perfect for spontaneous plans.
🇳🇵 Nepal – Visa-free for Indians! Walk in with your passport/Voter ID. Zero fees.
🇻🇳 Vietnam – e-Visa (USD 25). Valid up to 90 days. Affordable + smooth online process.
🇰🇭 Cambodia – e-Visa (~USD 30). Valid 3 months, 30-day stay. VOA also available.
🇱🇦 Laos – e-Visa/VOA (~USD 50). 60-day validity, 30-day stay. Easy and budget-friendly.

flashnews - Taman Makam Pahlawan (TMP) Cikutra di Jalan Cikutra No. 202, Kota Bandung, menjadi salah satu kompleks pemakaman pahlawan terbesar dan tertua di Indonesia. 

Kawasan seluas sekitar 7,5 hektare tersebut menjadi tempat peristirahatan bagi lebih dari lima ribu pahlawan, prajurit, dan tokoh yang berjasa dalam perjuangan kemerdekaan maupun pengabdian kepada negara.

TMP Cikutra diresmikan pada 10 November 1958 oleh Panglima Daerah Militer III/Siliwangi. 

Sebelumnya, kawasan ini sudah digunakan sebagai lokasi pemakaman para pejuang yang gugur dalam masa Revolusi Kemerdekaan 1945–1949, terutama dari Divisi Siliwangi. 

Seiring waktu, kompleks itu berkembang menjadi tempat pemakaman resmi bagi anggota TNI-Polri, veteran, serta pejabat sipil yang berjasa.

Di bagian depan taman makam berdiri Tugu Pahlawan dan monumen peringatan yang menjadi lokasi upacara kenegaraan setiap Hari Pahlawan dan Hari Kemerdekaan. 

Di tengah kompleks terdapat lapangan upacara dengan bendera merah putih yang berkibar sepanjang waktu. 

Makam-makam tersusun rapi dengan nisan berwarna putih yang mencantumkan nama, pangkat, dan satuan asal para pahlawan.

Beberapa tokoh penting yang dimakamkan di TMP Cikutra antara lain Letjen TNI (Purn.) R. A. Kosasih, Kolonel (Anumerta) Lili Suherli, serta sejumlah perwira yang gugur dalam pertempuran mempertahankan Bandung. 

Selain itu, banyak korban peristiwa DI/TII, PRRI/Permesta, dan konfrontasi Indonesia–Malaysia juga dimakamkan di tempat tersebut.

Setiap tahun, TMP Cikutra menjadi pusat kegiatan ziarah kenegaraan di Jawa Barat. 

Upacara tabur bunga dan penghormatan bagi para pahlawan rutin dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah daerah, TNI-Polri, serta berbagai lembaga pendidikan. 

Pengelolaan taman makam berada di bawah Kementerian Sosial melalui Dinas Sosial Provinsi Jawa Barat bekerja sama dengan Kodam III/Siliwangi.

Selain menjadi tempat pemakaman, TMP Cikutra berfungsi sebagai sarana edukasi sejarah bagi masyarakat dan generasi muda untuk mengenang perjuangan dan pengorbanan para pahlawan bangsa.

description:
#Ad Is Peru on your bucket list? Here are 4 must visit local experiences with Intrepid.

✨Machu Picchu - our Intrepid local guides brought to life the rich history of this Incan city.

✨Sacred Valley - visiting Parque Arqueológico Pisac was breathtaking. The terraces were so much bigger than I had imagined.

✨ AMA Restaurant in Urubamba - we loved the hot chocolate and brownie. We also learned that this restaurant provides employment opportunities to single mothers in the community.

✨ Mercado Central de San Pedro in Cusco - from coffee to potatoes to good luck charms, we loved exploring the San Pedro Market.

Intrepid helped me see and experience Peru in so many ways. From archaeological sites like Machu Picchu to wandering the San Pedro Market, Intrepid made each day of our 9-day trip count. I feel so recharged after this trip and I’m grateful I got to spend it with my sister.

Book your next adventure with Intrepid! ✈️

可愛小物都是限量送完為止唷！

我真的是從學生時代吃到出社會
暖湯12年愛上每一碗雙月雞湯🧡
連續7年獲得台北米其林必比登推薦

雞肉彈牙、雞湯濃郁又鮮甜，超好喝！

鱸魚湯的鱸魚很軟嫩，魚湯鮮味十足

週年慶回饋特價60元🔥
上面有滿滿的吻仔魚，拌一拌超好吃營養滿分！

#愛恨椒芝麵 獨家調味超好吃
有濃郁的芝麻香氣和椒麻香～超涮嘴！

#雙月乾蚵 使用東石鮮蚵，每一顆都好肥美

插畫杯墊有我超喜歡的滷味切盤，這個一定要收藏
米血糕、豆干、海帶、甜不辣、滷蛋都來一份吧！

大家趕快約朋友一起來吃飯吧！

description: فستان نسائي+ستره السعر 35.750

Kali ini kita main-main ke Aceh, masak Sie Reuboh Goreng dan Sambal Ganja (Asam Udeung). asli ini enak banget ✨🥹 kita berdua sampai nambah-nambah pas makan, lain kali mau bikin seu reuboh tanpa cabe ah, soalnya kemarin anak2 masih ngerasa agak pedas.

Pas ngegoreng daging sempet panik karena berbusa banyak mirip kaya lagi goreng telur dan tanya sama temen katanya itu reaksi dari denaturasi protein, makanya berbuih 🤭

Lagipula memang minyaknya juga kebanyakan hahah maklum first time.

Alhasil aduk terus dan diliat-liat takut banget dagingnya gosong, kan sayang kalo jadinya gagal. Alhamdulillah enggak eheheh 🥰

Aslinya pakai cuka ie jok, cuma karena ga punya dan mepet gak mau beli online setelah baca-baca gapapa kalau pakai cuka apel. Yaudah, kalo itu aku punya 🤭cuka dari kombucha juga ada eheheh.
Resep ib Qodridio

Yuk mari kita masak

✨Sie Reuboh dan Sambal Ganja (Asem Udeung)✨

Bahan Sie Reuboh:
350 gr daging sapi
1 sdm kunyit bubuk
1 sdm cabe bubuk
Garam 1/2 sdm
5 bh Cabe keriting, haluskan
150 ml Cuka ie jok
(Gak punya jadinya pake cuka apel 25 ml + 125ml air)
1 genggam Lengkuas, parut

4 siung Bawang merah
4 bh Cabe hijau

Cara :
Campur semua bumbu kecuali bawang merah dan cabe hijau
Lalu masak hingga air surut dan matang
Goreng, masukkan cabe hijau dan bw.merah sampai luar daging agak garing
Sajikan dengan taburan bawang goreng

Bahan Sambal Ganja:
4 siung Bawang merah
4 bh Cabe rawit
5 bh Belimbing sayur
1 batang Sereh
4 lembar Daun jeruk
1 sdt Garam
5 bh Udang matang
air jeruk nipis/lemon

Cara :
Bersihkan udang dan siram dengan lemon juice lalu masak di pan hingga matang
Ulek semua bahan, test rasa
Sajikan

The Lost Heaven in Sulawesi, Rammang-Rammang!⛰️☘️

Kawasan pegunungan Karst terbesar kedua di Dunia yang terletak di Maros, Sulawesi Selatan. Diakui UNESCO sebagai salah satu situs warisan dunia, WOW!! dan… ini masih di Indonesia kok🥹🤍

Untuk bisa ke kawasan ini, dari kota Makassar kalian bisa tempuh jalur darat sekitar 1 jam 15 menit, dilanjut naik kapal boat di pintu masuk kawasan. Begitu tiba, kalian akan disuguhi pemandangan pedesaan kecil di tengah sawah dan pegunungan kapur yang asri🌾

Video by @renan_ozturk @davemossop // A time-lapse reveal of Mt. Everest from a 18,000ft cave across the Khumbu glacier.  For this adventure, Dave @bushywayne and I were on a mission not to climb a mountain but to capture intimate moments with the Sherpa culture and the surrounding peaks they consider deities. ~

The temporary 'track' that the camera was moving on took hours to build into the very back of the cave.  In order to not bump the movement, Dave was trapped for hours.  Shivering, feeling a level of altitude sickness, but ultimately content, going into his mind and appreciating this moment at the roof of the world.  #intothemind @sherpascinema @camp4collective #NepaliLoveYou

Konsul RI Tawau Berharap Ordinan Buruh Sabah Yang Sudah Direvisi Dapat Meningkatkan Kesejahteraan PMI

”Masalah PMI di wilayah kerja Konsulat RI Tawau merupakan salah satu masalah yang menjadi perhatian serius pihak Konsulat. Karena bukan saja sebagai bagian upaya memberikan perlindungan kepada pekerja migran Indonesia (PMI) juga bagian yg untuk memastikan terpenuhinya hak pekerja sebelum bekerja, selama bekerja, dan setelah bekerja di Malaysia,” demikian disampaikan Konsul RI Tawau saat menerima kunjungan Penolong Kanan Pengarah Tenaga Kerja pada Jabatan Tenaga Kerja Kementerian Sumber Daya Sabah, Eko Bariono Bin Tumiran, di Konsulat RI Tawau, Kamis, 21 November 2024.

Dalam pertemuan ini Eko Bariono kemudian menyampaikan perkembangan terkini terkait dengan hasil penyempurnaan atau revisi Ordinan Buruh Sabah (OBS). OBS sudah disetujui oleh Persektuan dan akan berlaku di Sabah dalam waktu dekat. OBS tidak membedakan antara pekerja tempatan (lokal) ataupun pendatang (migran).

Beberapa hal baru dalam OBS yang disampaikan oleh Eko Bariono, yaitu penurunan jumlah jam kerja dari 48 jam menjadi 45 jam per minggu dan terdapat standar upah minimum baru dari RM 1.500 menjadi RM 1.700 yang akan diterapkan mulai Februari 2025 (untuk syarikat atau pemberi kerja besar) dan Agustus 2025 untuk pemberi kerja yang jumlah pekerjanya berada di bawah 5 (lima) orang.

Selain itu terdapat penambahan jumlah cuti bagi pekerja wanita yang melahirkan, dari 30 hari menjadi 90 hari. Terdapat juga cuti 7 hari bagi pekerja pria yang istrinya melahirkan. Adanya jaminan kesehatan yang lebih baik, termasuk pengaturan antara cuti sakit dan perawatan.

Konsul RI menyambut baik revisi OBS dan berharap bahwa dengan diberlakukannya OBS maka akan dapat memberikan manfaat yang lebih baik bagi PMI, khususnya dalam meningkatkan kesejahteraan mereka.

Konsul RI Tawau juga mengharapkan agar kerjasama dalam penanganan PMI di Sabah antara Konsulat RI tawau dengan Jabatan Tenaga Kerja Sabah dapat ditingkatkan di masa-masa mendatang, seperti melakukan kegiatan bersama di lapangan dan monitoring terhadap agen-agen pekerja.

description:
These Rice Paper Samosas by @emilymaun_nutrition are gluten-free, vegan, and packed with plant protein! Crispy on the outside, savory on the inside, and served with a tangy yogurt dip. 🌱✨

Comment ‘recipe’ to have the details sent to your DMs and keep tagging #feedfeed for a chance to be featured.

INGREDIENTS:
(makes 8-10 samosas)

For the samosas: 
1 medium-large potato (around 225g), peeled & chopped
1 tbsp olive oil (plus more for baking)
1 tsp cumin seeds
1 tsp grated ginger
2 garlic cloves, minced
1/2 a small onion, finely diced
1/4 tsp turmeric
1/2 tsp chilli powder
1/2 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp curry powder
Salt to taste
200g firm tofu
2/3 cup peas
8-10 rice paper sheets

For the yogurt dip:
1/3 cup yoghurt
Handful of coriander
Juice from 1/2 lemon
Pinch of salt
1 small garlic clove

The Ministry of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries (KKP) arrested three Malaysian-flagged vessels on Saturday for illegal fishing in the Malacca Strait. A total of 16 people were arrested from the three vessels.

"We detained the illegal fishing offenders from Malaysia, with three ships detected by our vessel, in the Malacca Strait, which is within the waters of the Republic of Indonesia," said Director General of Marine Resources and Fisheries Monitoring Pung Nugroho Saksono during a press conference at the Medan Fisheries Training and Extension Center, on Thursday.

description:
Entre o delírio e a lama, entre o sapo e o encantamento, nasceu o figurino que vesti com tecidos o delírio modernista de Raul Bopp.

Em Cobra Norato, mergulhei na floresta úmida das palavras, onde tudo é bicho, feitiço e brasilidade — e fiz do palco um igarapé de imagens costuradas com fios de sonho e barro.

As roupas — ou seriam cascas, couraças, peles de encantado? — saíram da mata de dentro, da boca do rio, do ventre da memória. Carregam em si o cheiro da terra molhada, a textura da cobra que dança, a plumagem do pássaro que filosofa, a risada do tatu  que escreve com o quadril.

Cada personagem, um pedaço desse Brasil profundo, em transe. Cada tecido, uma oferenda aos deuses das águas e às poéticas do esquecimento.

Mais que figurinos, são mapas de um Brasil que ainda se sonha: tropical, mítico, mestiço, e eternamente em desassossego.
.

description:
Kyle's tips on this lead route is to make sure you've read the route properly. Making adjustments mid-climb might be costly as the route can get pumpy towards the top.

As for the crux section at the roof, foot placement is crucial. The move will feel heavy but you just have to fight and keep the body tension.

The rest of the climb is flowy - just follow your instincts and let the wall dictate the movement.

description:
Gubernur Jawa Barat, Dedi Mulyadi, melakukan inspeksi mendadak ke Pasar Caringin di kawasan Ciparay, Kota Bandung, pada Rabu (30/4/2025). 

Dalam kunjungannya, Dedi mendapati kondisi pasar yang memprihatinkan, becek dan tumpukan sampah menggunung tidak terkelola dengan baik.

Ia memperkirakan jumlah sampah yang menumpuk di kawasan itu mencapai lebih dari 1.000 ton.

description:
Do you love boba or tea? 🧋 You guys gotta try my new fave boba spot. @7milestealab ‘s newest drinks are these fluff whip drinks which are a creamy delight with chewy boba pearls, a subtle hint of savory cheese foam, and cloud-like fluff whips. YUM! 

My husband loves the Pineapple Sunshine drink - it’s blended with pineapple puree, mango, and jasmine tea, with passionfruit seeds and jasmine jelly added. 
And my fave is the Guava Grape Bliss which is made with guava puree, strawberries, and jasmine green tea with added lime slices and smashed green grapes at the bottom. Perfection!

Check out @7milestealab 🧋 They have locations in Artesia, LA, Chino, and Torrance. Thank me later!

간만에 산 복권이 낙첨되었다며 아내가 농담삼아 속상해한다. 그날 밤, 아내와 아들이 자려고 들어간 침대방에서 둘의 수다 소리가 오랫동안 들리길래 일하다 궁금해서 몰래 다가가 엿들었다. “너는 요즘 부족함 없이 잘 지내고 있어? 엄마, 아빠가 잘 해주고 있는 것 같아? 먹고싶은 것도 먹고, 하고싶은 것도 하고?“ 엄마의 쏟아지는 질문을 곰곰히 듣던 아들은 ”네“ 하고 간단하게 대답하는가 싶더니 이내 ”가고싶은 곳도 다 가고요~ 사랑도 듬뿍 받고요~” 하고 덧붙인다.

아들과 함께 밥을 먹다가 갑자기 녀석이 이제 손가락 말고 팔꿈치로 물건을 가리킬 수 있다며 자랑한다. 온 우주는 고사하고, 아직 제 손가락 끝의 움직임도 한없이 새로울 작은 인간.. 이처럼 아직은 모든 게 충분한 우리 세식구의 어린 시절이 조금 더 길었으면 좋겠다는 생각이 들었다. 엄마랑 아빠가 뭘 잘 몰라서 허둥지둥해도, 이 어리숙하고 작은 시간들이 언제나 그리울 것만 같다.

Turmeric Nourish Bowl👇🏼😍 Creamy tahini dressing with crunchy chickpeas, cauliflower, pumpkin, quinoa, arugula, red onion, avocado, and pomegranate. It’s colourful, wholesome and bursting with flavour! 

If you haven’t checked out my previous nourish bowl recipes, save this video for later and go watch! Don’t forget to follow @tessbegg for more recipes🌿

Serves 2

Cauliflower, pumpkin and chickpeas:
1 small head of cauliflower, cut into florets (roughly 3 cups)
2 cups diced pumpkin or butternut
420g can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
Drizzle of olive oil to coat it all
1 tbsp smoked paprika
1 tsp turmeric
1 tsp cumin
2 tsp garlic powder
2 tsp onion powder
Generous pinch of salt and black pepper

Turmeric Tahini Dressing:
1/4 cup tahini (runny is best)
1 tbsp maple syrup
1 tsp turmeric
1/2 tsp garlic powder
Juice from 1 lemon
Water to thin as needed (about 1-2 tbsp)
Pinch of salt

Other:
1 avocado, sliced
2 cups cooked quinoa
2-3 cups arugula
1/2 red onion, sliced
1/3 cup pomegranate

Preheat oven to 200°C/390°F. Mix the seasoning/spices in a bowl. Add the cauliflower and pumpkin on a baking tray and the chickpeas on a separate tray. 

Add the olive oil and seasoning to each and toss to coat. Place in the oven (chickpeas on lower rack) and bake for 35 minutes (Cooking time may vary depending on oven).

Add the turmeric dressing ingredients in a bowl and mix together. Before serving give it another mix and add more water if it has thickened.

Once the veg and chickpeas are done, remove from oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes.

To assemble in a bowl, add the quinoa, arugula, cauliflower, pumpkin, chickpeas, avocado, red onion and pomegranate. Pour over the dressing and toss. Enjoy!

Store in the fridge for up to 4 days in an airtight container - best eaten same day.

description:
[TAIPEI] 🍲brought some friends from LA to @orangeshabushabu and reminded how good the food and service is. Our table of 7 shared the shortrib, iberico pork, Taiwanese pork and crab, which the server expertly cooked and peeled for us and added some crab to the signature congee that comes after. Takes about 15-20 minutes to simmer the rice + add all the mix ins, but satisfying that first bite after waiting. Mmmmmm yum 

Orange was one of my early posts on IG, before reels and multiple pics on one post. I guess we treated it more like stories back then -  so I posted an empty pot, a veggie fillled pot and congee. 

I heard some good advice to not be too precious about our work, and I tend to overthink posts nowadays which has taken the fun out of it… so trying to resist it having to be perfect or get 1000 likes or whatever and aim for posting again things I love or want to remember

Terpegun melihat keindahan rumah Allah yang baharu didirikan oleh keluarga Kumpulan Habib di Pulau Pinang. Terletak di Tanjung Tokong di atas tanah seluas 8,615 meter persegi, Masjid Habib bakal membuka pintunya hari ini, 5 Disember 2025 untuk jemaah menunaikan solat Jumaat pertama.

Masih mengekalkan keindahan permata sebagai konsep seni bina masjid, suntikan warisan Jawi Peranakan turut kelihatan menghiasi sekitar bangunan ibadat ini. Ia turut dilengkapi pelbagai kemudahan seperti dewan serba guna, bilik kuliah dan ruang solat yang luas menampung sehingga 1,600 jemaah dalam satu masa.

Bangga dengan kejayaan jutawan Muslim, Dato' Sri Meer Sadik Habib serta keluarga. Benarlah sebaik-baik harta adalah harta yang digunakan di jalan Allah. Dan sebaik-baik perbelanjaan adalah perbelanjaan untuk mencari reda Allah. Semoga segala kebaikan keluarga besar @habibjewelsofficial mendapat keberkatan dan dikurniakan syurga tertinggi Jannatul Firdaus ✨

SOM TAM VIETNAMESE ROLLS

INGREDIENTS 
8-10 Rice paper sheets
1 small Raw Papaya
2 Carrots
50gm French Beans
Coriander sprigs
3-4 cloves of Garlic
2 Birds Eye chilli 
Salt
1 Tomato deeded 
1/2 Lime
Handful of Mint leaves
Handful of Basil
Small piece of Jaggery
1 tbsp Tamarind paste
1 tbsp Light soy
1/4th cup Peanut Butter
Roasted Peanuts

METHOD 
1. Start off by chopping the raw papaya and carrots into thin matchsticks.
2. Allow them to soak in chilled water.
3. Boil the French beans until cooked through and set it aside.
4. For the dip, crush the garlic with chillies and salt in a mortar and pestle.
5. Add deseeded tomatoes, lime, mint, basil, jaggery and pound.
6. Now add the tamarind, soy, peanut butter and mix until emulsified well.
7. Remove the lime pieces and transfer to a dip bowl.
8. Top with some chopped roasted peanuts.
9. For the rolls, soften the rice paper sheets in cold water for a couple of seconds and add the raw papaya, carrots, French beans and coriander.
10. Serve with the dip!

🌿DOMINGO DE RAMOS | Monesterio Archicofradía Sacramental Virgen De Los Dolores 🌿

🙏¡SEÑOR, CON MI CORAZÓN, TE ACOMPAÑO EN ÉSTA SEMANA DE PASIÓN, PARA ALCANZAR TU RESURRECCIÓN! 🤍

Hoy comienza el camino…
Con palmas en las manos y fe en el alma, entramos contigo en Jerusalén. Que esta Semana Santa nos renueve por dentro y nos acerque más a Ti.

La Poesía, como el pan nuestro de cada día
Queremos acompañar tu sufrimiento

Al escuchar tu dolor, al verte en la cruz, brota de nosotros la ternura. Tú, Jesús, nos cambias el corazón de piedra por un corazón de carne.

Haznos también sensibles al dolor de tantos hermanos que tienen una vida dura, que no pueden con su cruz, y han de superar muchas dificultades cada día.

Queremos acompañar el sufrimiento de tantos hermanos en guerra, recordar a todos aquellos que en este momento, en algún lugar del mundo, están sufriendo por la locura de unos pocos, y a su alrededor hay dolor, muerte y destrucción.

Queremos acompañar el sufrimiento de tantos inmigrantes que se sienten entre nosotros fuera de su país, que les duele la soledad, la lejanía, la diferencia y la injusticia, que sepamos ser una mano tendida en su camino, un amigo, un compañero, un apoyo y una vida compartida.

Queremos acompañar el sufrimiento de todos aquellos que, como Tú, Señor, sufren en este momento soledad, desamor o incomprensión.
Queremos acompañar el sufrimiento de los parados,
los que sufren abusos laborales, los depresivos, los olvidados, los que no encuentran su lugar en el mundo, los que no pueden cubrir sus necesidades básicas, los que pasan hambre, y los que teniéndolo todo viven una vida sin rumbo y sin sentido.

Acompáñanos tú a todos, Señor, llénanos de tu presencia y de tu Amor, enséñanos a tratarnos unos a otros a tu manera, suavizándonos el peso de la vida.

💚Feliz Semana Santa familia y amigos 🌱

Ga naar kunsthal.nl/vip en meld je aan! 
 
To mark the festive opening of the exhibition DIVA, the Kunsthal is presenting the Diva Delivery contest. The winners will be welcomed as VIPs during this exclusive opening event at the Kunsthal on Saturday 26 October.

Topic Tuesday Ep. 25 👶🏼💤 with the amazing @vdhsleep - we spoke all things babies and their sleep! one of my main take aways was how imactful small changes (i’m talking 30 minutes) to a routine can literally transform a whole families life and their sleep. if you’re in the trenches right now, please take a listen! also if you’re pregnant i think it would be super helpful to learn about small tricks to get that baby sleeping well ☺️☺️ 

talking from my own experience, we basically has a year of no sleep with Z (due to his eczema and allergies) and it really impacted all of our lives. i spoke to victoria during this time to really understand what i could do to help. i really felt passionate about his sleep so although i felt like nothing was working … i stuck to a routine, preserved and when he healed he overnight became a dream sleeper! it’s like he knew what to do his body just wouldn’t quite let him yet. victoria was so helpful during this time ♥️

thank you for speaking with me Victoria - you’re so insightful and what you’re doing to help all these families is amazing - full ep. out now on youtube, apple podcasts and spotify!

description:
Boeing has unveiled the innovative REVOLVER launcher system. It is expected to become a game-changer that can transform the C-17 Globemaster III into a formidable hypersonic missile carrier.

This advanced launcher features two sequentially installed drums and an electromagnetic catapult mechanism, allowing the rapid launch of up to 12 Boeing X-51A Waverider hypersonic cruise missiles.

Its design ensures precise and speedy deployment of each missile, enhancing the US’ aerial strike capabilities.

Concepts such as this and Rapid Dragon, palletized munitions platform aim to transform cargo aircraft into missile trucks without significant modification and a very speedy install time. Given the large number of logistical support aircraft in the US inventory these systems would not only expand the arsenal and options available to commanders, but would also take pressure off of it's aging bomber and strike aircraft fleet.

description:
The last on our list is POPCORN!🍿
Yes, you heard it right! While microwave popcorn might seem like the perfect snack, it’s loaded with saturated fats and sodium both of which can lead to hypertension and clogged arteries. 

Energy Drinks & Flavored Vitamin Waters ⚡️
They might be marketed as “healthy,” but don’t be fooled. Most energy drinks and flavored waters contain artificial sweeteners, caffeine, artificial colors, and excess sugar. These can wreak havoc on your kids gut, trigger mental health issues like anxiety or depression, and even contribute to fatty liver disease. Opt for water or natural juices for a healthier energy boost.

French Fries 🍟
Yes, everyone’s favourite French fries from fast food joint might taste amazing, but they come with a hidden health risk. Overcooked fries contain acrylamide, a chemical linked to cancer, while reusing oil for frying is associated with heart disease. Stick to homemade fries or baked sweet potatoes for a much healthier and safer option!

Bubble Tea (aka Boba Tea)🧋
This trendy drink is loaded with sugar, and depending on where you get it, it has a lot of caffeine too! Plus, the chewy tapioca pearls pose a choking hazard for younger children. So if your kids are craving for boba teas avoid it and switch to healthier juices or homemade shakes. 

Colorful Candies & Cake Decorations 
While they look cute, those bright candies and cake fondants can be a hidden source of artificial additives that can worsen asthma, contribute to obesity, and even cause hyperactivity or irritability especially in kids. Better to keep those sugar bombs to a minimum.

With Christmas being around the corner, all parents must keep their children away from those eye catching candies & desserts!

description: Bollywood actor Akshay Kumar visited Haji Ali Dargah in Mumbai and donated ₹1.21 crore for its renovation. This act comes after his previous contribution of ₹3 crore for the construction of Ram Mandir in Ayodhya. The visit was made to seek blessings before the release of his film ‘Khel Khel Mein’ scheduled for August 15th, 2024. The actor’s gesture was widely appreciated by fans and the public, highlighting his support for religious and cultural heritage sites.

description:
During the April 9, 2025 protest at the KFC outlet in Karachi’s DHA area, some individuals were seen looting, including stealing Pepsi bottles, while chanting "Allahu Akbar. The group was protesting against U.S. and Israeli policies in Gaza.

This event, which began as a protest in solidarity with Palestinians, escalated into violence and looting. The chanting of religious slogans during acts of theft has drawn widespread criticism online, with many pointing out the hypocrisy and condemning the misuse of religion in such behavior.

The police intervened and arrested 10 people, but the video clips from the scene went viral, sparking outrage and debate over how such protests are being conducted.

description:
The legend returns — the 2025 Tata Sierra, starting at ₹ 11.49 Lakh (ex-showroom).

Key Specs & Highlights:
Engine Options:
1.5 L naturally aspirated petrol — 106 PS, 145 Nm available with 6-speed manual or 7-speed DCT.

1.5 L Hyperion turbo-petrol — 160 PS, 255 Nm; comes with a 6-speed automatic. 

1.5 L Kryojet diesel — 118 PS, torque up to 280 Nm; offered with both 6-speed manual and 6-speed automatic. 

Platform: Based on Tata’s new ARGOS architecture, which supports AWD in future versions. 

Boot Space: 622 litres (measured to roof), 60:40 split rear seats, can expand to 1,257 litres with seats folded. 

Interior & Features:
Triple-screen layout: 12.3″ infotainment, 12.3″ passenger screen, 10.25″ driver cluster. 

12-speaker JBL sound system with a centre soundbar. 

Panoramic sunroof, dual-zone climate control, ventilated front seats. 

360° camera, Level-2+ ADAS, head-up display, six airbags. 

Ruggedness & Design: 450 mm water-wading capacity, full-width LED DRL, 19-inch alloy wheels.

description:
One of the things I pour both time and passion into is crafting the most beautiful, captivating, and attainable prints of my original pieces 🤲❤️‍🔥

Over the years, I’ve been met with so many heartfelt responses to my work. A significant part of that love comes from a younger audience—often students. That’s why I’m committed to creating pieces that can still find a home, even if you haven’t yet graduated or landed a full-time job 🫡

The “art industry” tends to turn its nose up at posters—but since I don’t necessarily align myself with the industry to begin with, I don’t feel the need to play by its rules.

Part three of CHASING THE VISION begins here 🤎

1. Buka aplikasi Instagram dan pergi ke profil kamu.
2. Ketuk pada ‘Followers’ untuk melihat daftar pengikut.
3. Temukan followers yang ingin kamu hapus, kemudian ketuk tiga titik di sebelah kanan nama mereka.
4. Pilih ‘Remove’ dan konfirmasi penghapusan.

Dengan membersihkan followers yang tidak aktif atau spam, kamu bisa meningkatkan kualitas interaksi di akunmu! ✨ #InstagramTips #SocialMediaCleanUp”

PENGIKUT GUS MIFTAH DEMO, MENDESAK PRESIDEN PRABOWO MENOLAK PENGUNDURAN SANG GURU MEREKA

Aliansi Santri Jalanan menggelar aksi di Titik Nol Kilometer Yogyakarta, mendesak Presiden Prabowo Subianto menolak pengunduran diri Gus Miftah sebagai Utusan Khusus Presiden Bidang Kerukunan Beragama. Massa aksi menilai Gus Miftah telah memberikan kontribusi positif melalui dakwahnya, meski sempat menuai kontroversi.

“Itu semua karena kesalahan kecil beliau. Wong beliau juga bukan koruptor. Kami ingin Pak Presiden mendengar kami untuk menolak surat pengunduran diri beliau,” ujar salah satu simpatisan aksi yang enggan disebut namanya, Senin (9/12/2024). Mereka berencana mengirim surat resmi kepada Prabowo sebagai bentuk dukungan. Aksi diakhiri dengan lantunan selawat setelah 20 menit berlangsung.
